verdict.rationale: Incident management is a fair question for an application monitoring platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only alert rules plus integrations that hand incident work to third-party tools such as PagerDuty and incident.io. Nothing shows Sentry itself declaring incidents, keeping incident timelines, or managing on-call schedules or escalation policies.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can declare and track incidents with timelines, on-call schedules, and escalation policies
